t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Mono ikele mbangi, eh Nzambi na mono, na kuzaba nde: nge gangaka mono, sambu na kuzaba nge ti kupesa nge lukumu, se-sepi yayi, mono ke ndima bufioti na mo-no ye bunene na nge, bunsukami na mono, ye bumvwama na nge. Na ntwala na nge, Nzambi ya nkaka i-kele ve, ya ke gulusaka na bigonsa, yina ya ke zingaka na ngolo na yandi mosi kaka.
